quick_skim.title: Spooftral: Can Voxtral Audio-Language Model Detect Speech Spoofing?
quick_skim.abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) countermeasures (CMs) have shown strong performance in recent years. However, they often show degraded performance while facing unseen spoofing attacks and mismatched conditions. This study examines the Voxtral audio-language model (ALM) framework for spoofing detection, as a step toward combining CM capabilities within the ALM framework. We analyze how Voxtral captures spoofing cues through audio-text processing and propose an instruction-guided approach that uses label-sequence likelihoods to evaluate bonafide and spoofed speech. Experiments on the ASVspoof databases show that without task-specific adaptation, the LLM layers emphasize semantic representations, reducing the separability of spoof-discriminative acoustic cues compared to the Whisper-based audio encoder. Consequently, spoofing-related information becomes less separable after language-model processing. We also applied lightweight adaptation using weight-decomposed low-rank adaptation (DoRA) to the Voxtral model and propose the Spooftral model, achieving an equal error rate (EER) of 4.25% on the ASVspoof5 evaluation set.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Examines the Voxtral audio-language model for speech spoofing detection, analyzing how it captures spoofing cues and proposing an instruction-guided likelihood approach, showing LLM layers favor semantics over acoustic cues.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 自监督欺骗检测系统在面对未见攻击与失配条件时性能明显下降。本文考察Voxtral音频语言模型框架用于语音欺骗检测，分析其如何通过音频文本处理捕捉欺骗线索，并提出基于标签序列似然的指令引导方法。在ASVspoof数据库上实验表明，缺乏任务适配时LLM层更强调语义表征，削弱了欺骗判别声学线索的可分性。该工作为音频语言模型在跨域失配条件下的适配提供了洞见。
